review_notes.review_scope: Entire rendered answer and source descriptions reviewed. Retained independent substantive assertions and experimental tuples; repeated core-claim summaries, duplicate numerical restatements, source labels, editorial planning, suggested followups, confidence and deterministic ledgers excluded. Mixed paragraphs split where practical; localized error is identified when a compound unit remains.
